title: Design System: PICO SulTeng API Docs

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Logo blue fill for the main action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid #2a62b0; border-radius: 8px; background: #2a62b0; color: #f6f8fb; font: 600 15px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 27 45 / 0.2); transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1f4f94; border-color: #1f4f94; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2a62b0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid rgb(184 196 214 / 0.6); border-radius: 8px; background: #fbfcfe; color: #0f1b2d; font: 600 15px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #eef2f8; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2a62b0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sidebar Item
components.description: 36px sidebar row. Active uses the blue tint.
components.css: .ds-side { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 6px; color: #3d4d63; font: 400 14px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-side:hover { background: #eef2f8; color: #0f1b2d; } .ds-side-active { background: #e6eef9; color: #2a62b0; font-weight: 600; } .ds-side:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2a62b0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Method and State Pills
components.description: Method pill plus required, optional and deprecated states. Shape and text carry the state.
components.html: GET required optional deprecated
components.css: .ds-method { display: inline-flex; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e6eef9; color: #2a62b0; font: 700 12px/20px ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-state { display: inline-flex; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; font: 600 12px/20px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-on { background: #2a62b0; border-color: #2a62b0; color: #f6f8fb; } .ds-off { border-color: #b8c4d6; color: #56667c; } .ds-dep { border: 1px dashed #b8c4d6; color: #56667c; text-decoration: line-through; }

components.name: Callout
components.description: Note with a 1px border on all sides and a small icon.
components.html:
Note

components.css: .ds-callout { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(42 98 176 / 0.25); border-radius: 8px; background: #e6eef9; color: #0f1b2d; font: 400 14px/1.65 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-callout svg { flex: none; margin-top: 2px; color: #2a62b0; }

components.name: Table Card
components.description: Rounded bordered card around a data table.
components.css: .ds-table-card { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #dbe3ee; border-radius: 8px; background: #fbfcfe; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 27 45 / 0.06), 0 8px 24px rgb(15 27 45 / 0.06); } .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font: 400 14px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #0f1b2d; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-table th { padding: 10px 16px; background: #eef2f8; color: #56667c; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; text-align: left; } .ds-table td { padding: 12px 16px; border-top: 1px solid #e8eef6; vertical-align: top; } .ds-table tr:first-child td { border-top: 0; } .ds-table code { padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: #e6eef9; color: #2a62b0; font: 13px/24px ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; }

components.name: Code Panel
components.description: Navy panel with cURL and Response tabs and a copy button.
components.html:
cURLResponse
curl "https://api.example.com/v1"
components.css: .ds-code { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #26354d; border-radius: 8px; background: #0f1b2d; color: #dbe7f7; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 27 45 / 0.06), 0 8px 24px rgb(15 27 45 / 0.06); } .ds-code-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 24px; padding: 0 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #26354d; } .ds-tab { padding: 12px 0 10px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: #9aabc4; font: 600 13px/24px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab-on { border-color: #4ea9e3; color: #dbe7f7; } .ds-copy { margin: 0 0 6px auto; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #26354d; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #9aabc4; font: 600 13px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-copy:hover { background: rgb(219 231 247 / 0.08); color: #dbe7f7; } .ds-copy:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4ea9e3; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-code pre { margin: 0; padding: 24px; overflow-x: auto; font: 14px/24px ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; } .ds-code .k { color: #7db4ee; } .ds-code .s { color: #a7e3b8; }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Home stat group with a dated record and key path rows.
components.css: .ds-stat { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #dbe3ee; border-radius: 8px; background: #fbfcfe; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 27 45 / 0.04), 0 12px 32px rgb(15 27 45 / 0.06); font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #0f1b2d; } .ds-stat-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-stat h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-stat p { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; color: #56667c; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-stat dl { margin: 0; } .ds-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 6px 0; border-top: 1px solid #e8eef6; } .ds-row dt { font-size: 14px; color: #3d4d63; } .ds-row code { display: block; font: 11px/14px ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; color: #56667c; } .ds-row dd { margin: 0; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
This is a calm, precise API reference in the Stripe-docs manner. It is built around the blue of the PICO logo. It earns trust by craft, not by ornament. A developer finds an endpoint and copies a working cURL in seconds. A researcher finds a formula and its source.

The surface is a cool near-white ground with navy ink. One blue carries every action and every active state. Dark navy code panels sit on the page in both themes. Inter sets all the text. Numbers use tabular figures so columns line up. The dark theme is a full peer with its own measured values. It is not an inversion.

The build matches the approved comp (canon card, seed 8a7291fb). The reviewer sampled the hero pixels and found them equal to the comp: ground (246,248,251), code panel (15,27,45), button (42,98,176).
keyCharacteristics: One blue (logo blue #2a62b0) for action, links and active state. Everything else is neutral.
Hairline borders and an 8px radius. Depth is a soft two-layer shadow on cards only.
Dark navy code panels with the cURL and Response tabs and a copy button.
Tabular numerals everywhere numbers sit in a column.
State is always shape plus text, never color alone.
Light and dark are peers. Contrast is measured for both.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Logo blue is the only hue that marks action. Hairlines, text and surfaces stay neutral. Fields are never red, orange or purple. The logo is blue, red clashes with it, and this is a user decision.

rules.name: The Measured Contrast Rule
rules.body: Every text and ring color in the tokens comment of src/style.css has a measured ratio. Body text stays at 4.5 or higher. Large text and UI stay at 3 or higher. A new color needs a measured number before it ships.

rules.name: The No Pure Rule
rules.body: Text is never #000 or #fff. Ink is navy. On-brand is the ground color.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Code, tables and stat figures use tabular numerals so digits align.

rules.name: The Real Subscript Rule
rules.body: Symbols like R_t render as a real subscript through subscripts() in src/lib/wrap.ts.

rules.name: The Whole Token Rule
rules.body: URLs and key paths break only after a slash or a dot, through <wbr> (afterSlash, afterDot in src/lib/wrap.ts). They never break in the middle of a token.

rules.name: The Soft Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are blurred and low in opacity. Offset hard shadows are not used.

dos: Do use logo blue (#2a62b0) for every action and active state, and keep all other surfaces neutral.
Do pair every state with text or shape. Required, optional, paginated, deprecated, warning and success all carry a label.
Do keep both themes measured. Add dark values whenever you add a light value.
Do use 8px for cards and panels, 6px for controls and 999px for pills.
Do use tabular numerals for numbers and code.
Do break URLs and key paths only after a slash or a dot.
Do keep a visible focus ring on every control, blue on light and sky on dark and code.
Do give icon buttons a text label for assistive tech and a 44px target on touch devices.
donts: Do not use red, orange or purple fields or accents. The logo is blue and red clashes. This is a user decision.
Do not put a small label above a heading to introduce it.
Do not use a colored side border thicker than 1px. Borders are 1px on all sides.
Do not use emoji as icons. Icons come from icons/Icon.vue.
Do not break a URL or key path in the middle of a token.
Do not signal state by color alone.
Do not use pure black or pure white for text.
Do not use the sky accent for text or rings on a light surface. It measures 2.4.
